extension.summary: Sync Kodi favourites.xml with Google Drive
extension.description: Two-way household favourites merging via independent Google Drive device journals. Pair each Kodi device to the same account; restart Kodi after incoming changes.
extension.news:
v0.3.16 - Cache revision-verified Google Drive journals and skip downloading unchanged versions - Avoid re-writing identical local sync journals, snapshots, and cloud caches - Optional idle polling backoff (default on): 5 minutes to 15/30 minutes after long inactivity
v0.3.15 - Remove the Google OAuth settings category from the user interface - Preserve every OAuth and internal setting ID as hidden settings under General for backwards compatibility
v0.3.14 - Show a persistent result dialog after Sync favourites now instead of a brief notification - Offer Close Kodi / Later after any manual sync that updates favourites.xml, not just first import - Remember pending display updates from background syncs until Kodi actually restarts - Show a small background progress indicator during manual Google Drive sync
v0.3.13 - Convert recognized Kodi-local thumbnail paths to portable special:// references during sync - Normalize safe quoted Kodi filesystem paths inside favourite actions, too - Migrate recognized old cloud paths using append-only add/remove events without rewriting other devices' journals - Preserve network URLs, plugin links and unrelated local file paths without guessing
v0.3.12 - Use the same first-import Close Kodi prompt on all platforms, with Kodi's normal Quit builtin rather than RestartApp - Preserve Later option; never force-stop Kodi or reload its profile automatically
v0.3.11 - On the first import of existing favourites from Google Drive, offer an optional Kodi restart (Windows/Linux) or exit-and-reopen (Android/macOS) - Only prompt if unseen cloud favourites were actually written to userdata; never prompt on routine synchronizations - Continue preserving local favourites and independent two-way device journals
v0.3.10 - Sync at startup and periodically without a profile reload prompt - No unsolicited background download notifications; manual sync still reports status - Pairing and Sync Now save favourites silently without reloading Kodi
v0.3.9 - Fix Google account authorization persistence on Android/Kodi 22 using verified local add-on userdata credentials
v0.3.8 - Synchronize immediately after pairing; handle a missing userdata favourites.xml
v0.3.7 - Shorten the QR pairing instruction so it fits on one line and is no longer clipped by the custom dialog
v0.3.6 - Remove redundant pairing code beside QR countdown; retain full activation URL and QR - Keep the same countdown in the alternate QR fallback window
v0.3.5 - Fix QR image generator on Kodi Python 3.8 by using Kodi's supported script.module.qrcode 6.1+ dependency - Remove incompatible bundled QRCode 8.x Python library entirely - Continue writing PNGs without PIL, keep QR pairing enabled by default and both Kodi QR display paths
v0.3.4 - Make QR the actual default for upgraded installs, ignoring stale v0.3.1 pairing mode enums - Use an XML-independent QR dialog if the custom XML window cannot load - Report QR errors clearly in the fallback dialog and Kodi log rather than silently switching modes - Defer window controls updates until XML initialization completes
v0.3.3 - Fix pairing crash on Kodi with Python 3.8 by making bundled QR encoder type aliases compatible - Lazily load the QR encoder so an encoder failure cannot crash the entire pairing menu - Read integer enum settings using getSettingInt to avoid Invalid setting type at service startup - Keep QR as the default pairing method, with the skin-native text dialog as fallback
v0.3.2 - Default pairing to QR for fresh installs; preserve previously saved pairing-style choices - Read pairing-style enum using Kodi integer or legacy settings APIs - Generate QR images completely offline with bundled Python QR encoder (no third-party QR image service) - Report QR startup failures in the Kodi log and clean up temporary QR files
v0.3.1 - Default Google Drive pairing to Kodi native skin-styled progress dialog - Keep optional QR window with separate readable URL, status, code and Cancel layout - Fall back to native pairing if third-party QR image generation fails
v0.3.0 - Merge favourites across devices on initial connection without deleting existing entries - Use independent per-device Google Drive journals to avoid concurrent whole-file overwrites - Synchronize additions and observed deletions, including after a device was offline - Enable the previously commented-out service and add 1/5/15/30-minute automatic sync - Validate XML/journals, retain local backup copies, and atomically replace favourites.xml - Import the existing Google Drive favourites.xml on first v2 sync and preserve the legacy copy - Add Sync Now and Last Sync Status settings; restart Kodi after remote changes
v0.2.36 - Stop using `datetime.strptime` for Google Drive timestamps so Shield startup sync does not crash while parsing remote modified times
v0.2.35 - Log the full Python traceback for sync failures so intermittent Shield startup errors are diagnosable from Kodi logs
v0.2.34 - Refine the packaged README with the simplified user-facing intro and explicit bridge key-deletion notes
v0.2.33 - Rewrite the packaged README to focus on the OAuth bridge security model and shipped addon behavior
v0.2.32 - Add bridge refresh-secret support so startup token refresh uses a second device secret instead of a public refresh endpoint
v0.2.31 - Replace the add-on fanart with the provided artwork, resized into Kodi's JPEG fanart format
v0.2.30 - Restore hidden internal settings and harden setting reads so Android startup sync does not crash after UI cleanup
v0.2.29 - Simplify the General settings page to only Pair Google Drive now and Sync on Kodi startup
v0.2.28 - Replace the add-on icon with the provided Favourites Sync artwork
v0.2.27 - Move Pair Google Drive to the top of the General settings section for faster setup
v0.2.26 - Remove the visible Remote Storage settings category so normal users stay on the supported appdata sync path
v0.2.25 - Replace blank placeholder artwork with a real add-on icon and fanart for Kodi UI
v0.2.23 - Repackage the last known-good Android behavior from the 0.2.15 code path as a newer update so Kodi can install the stable rollback cleanly
v0.2.22 - Roll back to the pre-experiment sync behavior used before the post-download UI refresh tests on Android
v0.2.21 - Roll back the post-download UI refresh experiment and restore the previously stable sync behavior on Android

v0.2.17 - Revert the experimental post-download skin reload after it caused a runtime error on Android
v0.2.16 - Try a best-effort Kodi skin reload after downloading a newer remote favourites.xml so favourites may refresh without a second reboot
v0.2.15 - Log the effective upload toggle at sync start so Kodi UI/state mismatches are visible in the log
v0.2.14 - Log the granted OAuth scope string at sync start so Drive app-data scope mismatches are visible in Kodi logs

v0.2.12 - Add targeted pairing and token persistence logging so Kodi-side OAuth handoff failures are visible in the log
v0.2.11 - Improve QR dialog readability with brighter text, better spacing, and wrapped URL display
v0.2.10 - Bundle a local skin texture for the pairing dialog so the modal background does not depend on Kodi skin assets
v0.2.9 - Make the pairing QR dialog fully opaque so it reads as a proper modal over Kodi settings

v0.2.7 - Rework the Kodi QR dialog layout using a proven dialog window structure and local QR image file rendering
v0.2.6 - Send the pairing creation request as explicit JSON so the Vercel bridge parses Kodi requests correctly
v0.2.5 - Show a Kodi QR pairing dialog so users can scan the Vercel sign-in link from their phone - Stop auto-opening the system browser during pairing - Fix pairing progress updates for Kodi builds that only accept the older DialogProgress signature
v0.2.4 - Route the Google Drive pairing action through RunPlugin for better compatibility on Kodi/macOS - Add a startup fallback toggle to launch pairing on the next Kodi start if direct triggering is unavailable
